reasoning: The pigeonhole principle states that placing 7 pigeons into 6 holes forces at least one hole to contain more than one pigeon, violating the constraint of at most one per hole. Thus, no solution exists.
cot_trace: We need to place 7 pigeons into 6 holes with each hole at most one pigeon. That's impossible because pigeonhole principle: 7 pigeons into 6 holes means at least one hole has at least 2 pigeons. So unsatisfiable.
